meta.parties: Urban Council of Dehiwela Mount Lavinia Et Al. v. Andy Silva

rules.statement: An Urban Council can purchase land for the recovery of rates and taxes without prior sanction from the Local Government Board, as this falls under a special power saved by section 47(c) of the Local Government Ordinance (Cap. 195).
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore it would be necessary to obtain the prior sanction of the Local Government Board to purchase the land only if that purchase is made for the purpose of carrying out the duties enumerated in section 46. It cannot be contended that the purchase of this particular land was made for carrying out the duties enumerated in section 46. Hence the provisions of section 47 (c) would not apply to this purchase."
